description: Header file defining the PDBSourceLineWriter class and related structures for handling PDB and PE file information, primarily used for debugging symbol mapping in Windows environments.

classes.name: PDBSourceLineWriter
classes.description: Class for reading and writing debug symbol information from PDB files and associated PE files, including generating source line maps.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a specified debug symbol or executable file and prepares for processing.

methods.name: SetCodeFile
methods.description: Sets the full path to the code file associated with the PDB.

methods.name: WriteMap
methods.description: Outputs a source line map to a specified file stream.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the current PDB file and releases resources.

methods.name: GetModuleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the debug module.

methods.name: GetPEInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the associated PE file.

methods.name: UsesGUID
methods.description: Determines if the opened PDB uses a GUID for identification.
